20154.long_desc: Make your light gun machine stand out with our Arcooda Pedal Assembly with LED and USB support, making your existing arcade machine, homebrew, or Arcooda arcade machine come alive. Made with 2mm steel constructions and 4.5mm checkerplate, the Arcooda gun pedal assembly is powder coated (not painted), with interchangeable parts with the Namco original pedal assembly, and weights 4.5kgs for arcade commercial use. it has underfloor programmable LED light circuit, as well as LED back plate that allows light to come through the metal front grill. By matching with the correct cables/parts, you can make the Arcooda pedal assembly have one static colour, mixed patterns, or, programmed LED colours depending on press/game functions. Our highest quality Gun Pedal Assembly is available for your favourite shooter arcade machines. This is the microswitch version assembly and is a direct replacement for Namco Time Crisis machine series. Arcade Use & Compatibility The pedal assembly is suitable for a large variety of your favourite Namco shooter machines: - Time Crisis 1 - Time Crisis 2 - Time Crisis 3 - Time Crisis 4 - Razing Storm - Crisis Zone - Blade of Honor Home Use & Light Gun Machines Choose between standard wiring which has simple switch circuit - this can be used for JAMMA game boards or simple switch based homebrew machines, or, use our USB wiring harness which offers USB programmable pedal switch via connection to your PC/computer. If you are using this foot pedal assembly with your PC, order the #20210 harness which has embedded chipset that when you plug in your foot pedal assembly into your arcade or homebrew cabinet Pedal Colour Options The Gun Pedal Assembly comes in the following options: - Black - Red (10pc minimum order) - Yellow (10pc minimum order) - White (10pc minimum order) Upgradeability - Opto Switch: easily replace the microswitch with Opto switch for Time Crisis 4. Cable Options Depending on what system you are connecting to with your pedal, we provide you with options of cables to assist you. Pedal Assembly Cable for Namco Arcade Machine 15cm Perfect for use with an original Namco Time Crisis 1 or 2 Cabinet, as well as wanting to use for microswitch function only. Pedal Assembly Cable with Switch and LED Plug 200cm Choose this option if considering using with pedal assembly in the future with the LED upgrade and with microswitch function Pedal Assembly Cable with Switch LED and USB Plug 200cm This option is perfect if you are looking to acquire the LED upgrade alongside USB support via PC and computer use. Bracket Options We also provide options to connect your foot pedal assembly to your arcade cabinet, as a set of 2 pieces including 8 mounting bolts. Made from 2.4mm powder coated steel, it includes left and right brackets in either Black, or Red. Dual Plug Position To match the Namco arcade machines, the default position of the plug is on the top position. However, if you are using for home use, simply open the pedal assembly and move the plug position to the bottom opening - this avoids any trip hazard if you plan to use the arcade pedal assembly version for home use. The default position is the bottom opening for this pedal assembly model. Programmable LED Lighting Function The feature that makes this pedal really stand out from the rest is the programmable LED Lighting function. Want the lights to go red when you activate? Connect the LED Controller and use the remote control to easily switch colours!
